english.title: Intentionally obstruct / impede person exercising power / duty under Air Navigation Order / Safety Regulation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed or impeded **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person who was exercising a power or performing a duty under

english.legislation: Contrary to articles 263 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
